pddl.domain_pddl:
(define (domain south-asia-clean-cooking)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types
    unit period coverage-tier budget-level
  )

  (:predicates
    ;; Infrastructure readiness (initial vs built in period ?p)
    (lpg-init-ready ?u - unit)
    (grid-init-ready ?u - unit)
    (lpg-infra-built-at ?u - unit ?p - period)
    (grid-infra-built-at ?u - unit ?p - period)
    (lpg-infra-built ?u - unit)
    (grid-infra-built ?u - unit)

    ;; Coverage state and linear tier progression
    (cov-tier ?u - unit ?c - coverage-tier)
    (next-cov ?c1 ?c2 - coverage-tier)
    (clean-fuel-deployed ?u - unit)

    ;; Sequential period ordering & strictly-earlier prerequisite relation
    (active-period ?p - period)
    (next-period ?p1 ?p2 - period)
    (strictly-before ?p1 ?p2 - period)

    ;; Per-unit-per-period rollout guard (respects per-period adoption cap)
    (slot-open ?u - unit ?p - period)

    ;; Ordered discrete budget levels (avoids unordered-token symmetry blow-up)
    (budget-level ?b - budget-level)
    (next-budget ?b1 ?b2 - budget-level)
  )

  ;; Build LPG infrastructure in active period ?p (unlocks strictly later periods)
  (:action build-lpg-infra
    :parameters (?u - unit ?p - period ?b1 ?b2 - budget-level)
    :precondition (and
      (active-period ?p)
      (budget-level ?b1)
      (next-budget ?b1 ?b2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (lpg-infra-built-at ?u ?p)
      (lpg-infra-built ?u)
      (not (budget-level ?b1))
      (budget-level ?b2)
    )
  )

  ;; Build electric cooking grid infrastructure in active period ?p
  (:action build-grid-infra
    :parameters (?u - unit ?p - period ?b1 ?b2 - budget-level)
    :precondition (and
      (active-period ?p)
      (budget-level ?b1)
      (next-budget ?b1 ?b2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (grid-infra-built-at ?u ?p)
      (grid-infra-built ?u)
      (not (budget-level ?b1))
      (budget-level ?b2)
    )
  )

  ;; Rollout LPG subsidy in initially ready unit (urban)
  (:action rollout-lpg-init-ready
    :parameters (?u - unit ?p - period ?c1 ?c2 - coverage-tier ?b1 ?b2 - budget-level)
    :precondition (and
      (lpg-init-ready ?u)
      (active-period ?p)
      (slot-open ?u ?p)
      (cov-tier ?u ?c1)
      (next-cov ?c1 ?c2)
      (budget-level ?b1)
      (next-budget ?b1 ?b2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (cov-tier ?u ?c1))
      (cov-tier ?u ?c2)
      (not (slot-open ?u ?p))
      (clean-fuel-deployed ?u)
      (not (budget-level ?b1))
      (budget-level ?b2)
    )
  )

  ;; Rollout LPG subsidy in unready unit after infra built in a STRICTLY earlier period
  (:action rollout-lpg-after-infra
    :parameters (?u - unit ?p_infra ?p - period ?c1 ?c2 - coverage-tier ?b1 ?b2 - budget-level)
    :precondition (and
      (lpg-infra-built-at ?u ?p_infra)
      (strictly-before ?p_infra ?p)
      (active-period ?p)
      (slot-open ?u ?p)
      (cov-tier ?u ?c1)
      (next-cov ?c1 ?c2)
      (budget-level ?b1)
      (next-budget ?b1 ?b2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (cov-tier ?u ?c1))
      (cov-tier ?u ?c2)
      (not (slot-open ?u ?p))
      (clean-fuel-deployed ?u)
      (not (budget-level ?b1))
      (budget-level ?b2)
    )
  )

  ;; Rollout electric induction in initially grid-ready unit
  (:action rollout-electric-init-ready
    :parameters (?u - unit ?p - period ?c1 ?c2 - coverage-tier ?b1 ?b2 - budget-level)
    :precondition (and
      (grid-init-ready ?u)
      (active-period ?p)
      (slot-open ?u ?p)
      (cov-tier ?u ?c1)
      (next-cov ?c1 ?c2)
      (budget-level ?b1)
      (next-budget ?b1 ?b2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (cov-tier ?u ?c1))
      (cov-tier ?u ?c2)
      (not (slot-open ?u ?p))
      (clean-fuel-deployed ?u)
      (not (budget-level ?b1))
      (budget-level ?b2)
    )
  )

  ;; Rollout electric induction after grid built in a STRICTLY earlier period
  (:action rollout-electric-after-infra
    :parameters (?u - unit ?p_infra ?p - period ?c1 ?c2 - coverage-tier ?b1 ?b2 - budget-level)
    :precondition (and
      (grid-infra-built-at ?u ?p_infra)
      (strictly-before ?p_infra ?p)
      (active-period ?p)
      (slot-open ?u ?p)
      (cov-tier ?u ?c1)
      (next-cov ?c1 ?c2)
      (budget-level ?b1)
      (next-budget ?b1 ?b2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (cov-tier ?u ?c1))
      (cov-tier ?u ?c2)
      (not (slot-open ?u ?p))
      (clean-fuel-deployed ?u)
      (not (budget-level ?b1))
      (budget-level ?b2)
    )
  )

  ;; Rollout improved biomass (no LPG/grid infrastructure prerequisite)
  (:action rollout-improved-biomass
    :parameters (?u - unit ?p - period ?c1 ?c2 - coverage-tier ?b1 ?b2 - budget-level)
    :precondition (and
      (active-period ?p)
      (slot-open ?u ?p)
      (cov-tier ?u ?c1)
      (next-cov ?c1 ?c2)
      (budget-level ?b1)
      (next-budget ?b1 ?b2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (cov-tier ?u ?c1))
      (cov-tier ?u ?c2)
      (not (slot-open ?u ?p))
      (not (budget-level ?b1))
      (budget-level ?b2)
    )
  )

  ;; Advance sequentially between 5-year periods
  (:action advance-period
    :parameters (?p1 ?p2 - period)
    :precondition (and
      (active-period ?p1)
      (next-period ?p1 ?p2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (active-period ?p1))
      (active-period ?p2)
    )
  )
)
pddl.problem_pddl:
(define (problem ind-npl-clean-cooking-existing-infra-2026-2040)
  (:domain south-asia-clean-cooking)

  (:objects
    ind_urban ind_rural npl_urban npl_rural - unit
    p1 p2 p3 - period
    c0 c1 c2 - coverage-tier
    b0 b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 b8 - budget-level
  )

  (:init
    ;; Initial infrastructure readiness from real baseline_unit_state.csv
    ;; (IND_rural is LPG-ready, grid-unready; NPL_rural is unready; infra_lpg_grid disabled)
    (lpg-init-ready ind_urban)
    (grid-init-ready ind_urban)
    (lpg-init-ready ind_rural)
    (lpg-init-ready npl_urban)
    (grid-init-ready npl_urban)

    ;; Initial zero additional coverage above 2040 BAU
    (cov-tier ind_urban c0)
    (cov-tier ind_rural c0)
    (cov-tier npl_urban c0)
    (cov-tier npl_rural c0)

    ;; Linear coverage tier chain (each step = +0.10 coverage increment, capped at headroom)
    (next-cov c0 c1)
    (next-cov c1 c2)

    ;; Three 5-year periods (P1: 2026-2030, P2: 2031-2035, P3: 2036-2040)
    (active-period p1)
    (next-period p1 p2)
    (next-period p2 p3)
    (strictly-before p1 p2)
    (strictly-before p1 p3)
    (strictly-before p2 p3)

    ;; One cooking rollout slot per unit per period (enforces adoption cap)
    (slot-open ind_urban p1)
    (slot-open ind_urban p2)
    (slot-open ind_urban p3)
    (slot-open ind_rural p1)
    (slot-open ind_rural p2)
    (slot-open ind_rural p3)
    (slot-open npl_urban p1)
    (slot-open npl_urban p2)
    (slot-open npl_urban p3)
    (slot-open npl_rural p1)
    (slot-open npl_rural p2)
    (slot-open npl_rural p3)

    ;; Discrete budget levels (8 action units)
    (budget-level b8)
    (next-budget b8 b7)
    (next-budget b7 b6)
    (next-budget b6 b5)
    (next-budget b5 b4)
    (next-budget b4 b3)
    (next-budget b3 b2)
    (next-budget b2 b1)
    (next-budget b1 b0)
  )

  (:goal (and
    (cov-tier ind_urban c1)
    (cov-tier ind_rural c2)
    (cov-tier npl_urban c1)
    (cov-tier npl_rural c2)
    (clean-fuel-deployed ind_urban)
    (clean-fuel-deployed ind_rural)
    (clean-fuel-deployed npl_urban)
  ))
)
